judgments.justification: "outperformed Owlery-Enc by a mean of 2.1 macro-F1 points (81.9 ± 0.5 vs 79.8 ± 0.8; paired t-test, p < 0.001, 95% CI [1.58, 2.69]"
Only the average across splits is reported; no per-platform results (Gildcrest, Nettlebank, Pikestaff) are stated.
"higher for Brackenridge-Tox than Owlery-Enc on all four subtypes (e.g., identity attack: 70.2 vs 66.5" shows identity attack with the largest gap.
Calls Cobble-Board "unseen" and notes only missing significance test; omits that it was used for tuning and had no test partition.
Treats Cobble-Board as an unseen platform and does not say generalization remains unanswered because it was tuned on.
Reports 81.9 vs 79.8 on training platforms' test splits with significant paired t-test (p < 0.001).
Describes Cobble-Board as "the unseen" platform and presents 71.8 vs 68.9 as a transfer result, not acknowledging it was the tuning set.
